intro.text: An Alethi highprince whose commerce-focused warcamp on the Shattered Plains supplies the other camps.
An Alethi highprince and shrewd businessman, named Highprince of Commerce by Dalinar Kholin.

items.text: Sebarial was already a highprince before Gavilar united Alethkar, and avoided taking sides: on the day of the battle against Kalanor he claimed supply problems kept him away. At Gavilar's funeral he seemed to expect a drunken Dalinar to make a scene.

Sebarial came to the Shattered Plains with the other highprinces but, seeing the Alethi would never fully leave, built mills, farms, markets and tenements instead of joining plateau runs. His warcamp was laid out like a true city.

At a meeting of the king and highprinces, where he mostly snacked and made remarks, Shallan Davar claimed he had been first to offer her a place to stay. He backed her story, claimed a distant relation, gave her rooms in his manor and made her a clerk for his finances.
Known for idleness and shirking his duties, Sebarial shocked Dalinar by bringing his army on the expedition to end the war with the Parshendi.
Sebarial joined the planning as the army moved towards Narak. Dalinar kept him in the command tent and gave his army to Teleb, with the Shardbearers Rust and Serugiadis.

When the Everstorm came, Sebarial marched his and Roion's armies onto the Oathgate plateau in good order, then sat down with Palona to eat fruit and drink Dalinar's wine. He moved into Urithiru with the survivors, and his warcamp followed.

One of the few survivors Dalinar fully trusted, Sebarial was named Highprince of Commerce. He gave most of his army to the Kholins, keeping a single division, and attended Dalinar and Navani's wedding.
He gave Shallan a room in his section of the tower, decorated his own quarters lavishly, kept commerce flowing at all hours, quietly approved the Breakaway market and kept liquor taxes low.
Sebarial and Palona arrived late to the meeting of monarchs, stood by the food table and made sarcastic remarks. Navani gave Oathgate taxes to Queen Fen rather than to him.
While Dalinar withdrew, Sebarial and other highprinces brought their concerns to Navani. He bluntly asked whether Dalinar's plans were secretly a way to dominate the world.
Sebarial stayed in Urithiru while Dalinar went to Thaylen City. When singers invaded the tower, he followed Aladar's lead in pulling troops higher up.
When the Kholins chose Jasnah to rule Alethkar, Sebarial, who had pretended to sleep through the discussion, was pleased and enjoyed the others' worried looks.

A year on, Sebarial stayed to help run Urithiru while the army went to Emul. Navani asked him to bring the old warcamps under the coalition's control, and advised him to show Palona he was sincere. He set up a safer route to the tower and suspected the warcamps' underworld had been taken over.
Palona long refused to marry him. When Dalinar returned from the Spiritual Realm, the two were wearing Herdazian wedding ribbons.

appearance.text: Plump and bearded. He wore a takama until some time after the move to Urithiru, then took to clothes like a Thaylen merchant's.

personality.text: Outwardly rude, lazy and vulgar, he seems a fool but is intelligent and sly, quietly following politics.
He is a shrewd businessman and has a gift for hiring the right people. Beneath his flippancy, he wants to be useful.
